anomalies.description: Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one initiates a grab or strike, and the other counters, leading to a struggle.
After initial mutual combat, one man overpowers the other, lifts him, and throws him over a railing—indicating the victim is no longer able to resist, making the act abusive.
The sequence from grab to throw constitutes a continuous violent physical confrontation; the initial phase is mutual, supporting a fighting classification overlapping with abuse.
A man in a black leather jacket is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip in frame f14 (19.0s), and he maintains aim in f15 (19.5s).
